from PyQt5.uic import loadUi
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QApplication,QMessageBox,QTableWidgetItem
from random import randint
from numpy import array

def remplir_mat():
    global n,m
    n=win.n.text()
    if n=="" or not n.isdigit() or not(4<=int(n)<=10):
        QMessageBox.critical(win,"erreur" ,"taper un entier entre 4 et 10")
    else:
        n=int(n)
        m=array([[str()]*n]*n)
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                m[i,j]=chr(randint(ord('A'),ord('Z')))
def affiche_mat():
    win.matrice.setRowCount(n)
    win.matrice.setColumnCount(n)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            win.matrice.setItem(i,j,QTableWidgetItem (m[i,j]))
            
def parcour_mat():
    f=open("f_inter.txt","w")
    cf=n-1
    for i in range(n//2+1):
        parcour=""
        for j in range(i,cf+1):
            parcour+=m[i,j]
        for j in range(i+1,cf+1):
            parcour+=m[j,cf]
        for j in range(cf-1,i-1,-1):
            parcour+=m[cf,j]
        for j in range(cf-1,i,-1):
            parcour+=m[j,i]
        f.write(parcour+"\n")
        cf-=1
    f.close()   
def affiche_parcours():
    f=open("f_inter.txt","r")
    ch=f.readline()
    win.list_parcours.clear()
    while ch!="":
        win.list_parcours.addItem(ch.strip())
        ch=f.readline()
    f.close()
    
def generer_Code():
    f1=open("f_inter.txt","r")
    f2=open("f_code.txt" ,"w")
    f2.write(convb10_bb(n,2)+"\n")
    ch=f1.readline().strip() # lecture de la premiére ligne (une seule fois)
    while ch !="":
        ligne=""
        for i in range (len(ch)):
            ligne=ligne+convb10_bb(ord(ch[i]),16)+"#"
        f2.write(ligne+"\n")
        ch=f1.readline().strip() #lecture reste de fichier ligne par ligne 
    f1.close()
    f2.close()

def convb10_bb(n,b):
    ch=""
    while n !=0 :
        r=n%b
        n=n//b
        if r>=10:
            ch1=chr(r+55)
        else:
            ch1=str(r)
        ch=ch1+ch
    return ch
            

def affiche_code():
    f=open("f_code.txt","r")
    ch=f.readline()
    win.list_code.clear()
    while ch!="":
        win.list_code.addItem(ch.strip())
        ch=f.readline()
    f.close()
    
    





app=QApplication([])
win=loadUi("interface_diffusion.ui")
win.show()
win.btn1.clicked.connect(remplir_mat)
win.btn2.clicked.connect(affiche_mat)
win.btn3.clicked.connect(parcour_mat)
win.btn4.clicked.connect(affiche_parcours)
win.btn5.clicked.connect(generer_Code)
win.btn6.clicked.connect(affiche_code)

app.exec_()
